info.title: School Wall API
info.description: Complete registered School Wall HTTP API. The default server is the versioned /api/v1 adapter. Legacy /api methods retain their original JSON payloads. Operations marked x-internal use same-origin Dashboard paths, ticket or cookie authentication and CSRF protection where applicable. Explicit GET operations have HTTP HEAD support through Express or discovery dispatch. Allowed browser CORS preflight OPTIONS requests are handled globally. Static files and site pages are outside this contract. Use HTTPS for authenticated and management traffic.

post.summary: Send private message or wall-scoped confession with optional reply
post.description: Private: accepted friend OR shared active wall, no block, active recipient, no anonymous flag. Confession: both active members of selected wall. Reply source must be visible, same participants/type/wall, nonanonymous and not revoked. A supplied client_message_id is unique per sender: replaying the same normalized payload returns the existing id with deduplicated=true. Different payload returns 409 CLIENT_MESSAGE_CONFLICT. Hidden/revoked original returns 409 CLIENT_MESSAGE_UNAVAILABLE. Never generate a new cid merely because a response was lost. When matching a committed cid, the server acknowledges the existing record without rewriting it or restoring a hidden peer copy. Confession letters accept allow_replies (default false); use the confession thread reply endpoint, especially for anonymous letters. The existing send endpoint cannot bypass the original letter reply permission. Confession presentation adds kind/root/reply/identity fields; anonymous sender identity remains hidden after approval, with approved identity available only in revealed_sender.

get.summary: Export filtered dashboard records as CSV
get.description: Internal GET /dashboard/api/export, on the same deployment origin root only. Requires sw_dash cookie and live global.dashboard; Bearer-only requests, including aud=dashboard tickets, return 401. Supplied Origin must match the server origin and supplied Sec-Fetch-Site must be same-origin or none; these read-only GET requests need no CSRF header. type is required: users additionally requires global.user.manage, posts requires global.moderate, announcements requires global.announcement. No wall-header selector is used. The selected dataset uses the matching filters below; other dataset filters have no effect. Text filters are trimmed and truncated to 100 characters and use literal substring matching with SQL wildcard escaping. Non-string text filters and unsupported role/status values are ignored. No pagination parameters or caller-selected export limit exist. More than 10,000 matching rows returns 413 without a partial CSV. Success is an attachment named users.csv, posts.csv or announcements.csv, text/csv; charset=utf-8, with UTF-8 BOM and CRLF lines. CSV cells quote embedded quotes and protect spreadsheet formula prefixes. Users include ID, username, nickname, real_name only when show_real_name=1 (otherwise empty), role, status, ban_until and created_at. Posts include ID, content, category, display author, cached like/comment counts and created_at; anonymous authors remain anonymous and no author ID is exported. Announcements include global-scope ID, title, content, pin state, deletion time and created_at. Private messages, IP addresses and hidden real names are excluded. AdminOverviewRange.description: Inclusive local-calendar window ending today. Calendar arithmetic handles daylight-saving days; existing timezone-less SQLite timestamps are grouped as stored, not reinterpreted as UTC.

end_date.description: Last included server-local calendar date, including today.

timezone.description: Current server IANA time zone; historical server time-zone changes cannot be reconstructed.

utc_offset_minutes.description: Current server UTC offset in minutes; not a historical offset for every stored record.

AdminOverviewTotals.description: Lifetime counts across all authorized walls in scope, not just the daily window or the returned wall rows. Global account counts are nullable.

members.description: Active membership relations across authorized walls; a person in two walls counts twice.

anonymous_posts.description: Aggregate anonymous-post count only; no author identity or attribution is returned.

likes.description: Actual like rows, not denormalized post counters.

pending.description: Sum of authorized pending categories; equals pending.total.

AdminOverviewActivity.description: Counts for today in the server-local calendar.

members.description: Active membership relations created on this date; not distinct people.

AdminOverviewDailyActivity.description: Current surviving records grouped by their stored creation date; not a durable event or audit log.

date.description: Server-local calendar date, in ascending order.

members.description: Active membership relations created on this date; not distinct people.

AdminOverviewWall.description: A permitted wall. Each wall must pass effective wall.stats.view, including explicit grants and denies.

name.description: Wall display name, limited to 200 characters.

status.description: Stored wall status, normally active or disabled; unknown legacy values are retained. Disabled walls are visible only in global scope with global.moderate.

posts_in_range.description: Posts created within the inclusive range.

AdminOverviewWallsMeta.description: At most 100 rows sorted by posts_in_range descending, posts descending, then id ascending. Not a pagination cursor.

total.description: Number of authorized wall rows before the display limit.

truncated.description: True when authorized wall rows are omitted; aggregate totals still cover the entire authorized scope.

AdminOverviewPending.description: Per-wall queues also require that wall to pass statistics authorization. Safety and bug queues include pending and processing; other queues include pending only. user_reports covers all walls globally or the selected wall when filtered.

wall_applications.description: Requires global.wall.approve. Available only without wall_id.

bug_reports.description: Requires global.bug.handle. Available only without wall_id.

total.description: Sum of categories the caller may see; null categories do not reveal hidden queues.

AdminOverviewTodo.description: Only authorized positive queues become todos. No message bodies, report contents, personal names or IP addresses.

title.description: Localized display label; use key and permission for program logic.

wall_id.description: For members, post_reports and safety_reports always the wall ID. user_reports uses the filter ID or null globally. wall_applications and bug_reports always use null.

permission.description: Business permission for the queue. Safety prefers global.safety.handle when granted; visibility does not grant unrelated actions.

AdminOverviewTodosMeta.description: At most 30 rows sorted by count descending, key, then wall_id ascending. pending aggregates remain complete.

total.description: Number of authorized task rows before the display limit; not the sum of queue counts.

truncated.description: True when authorized task rows were omitted from todos.

AdminOverviewSystem.description: Requires global.dashboard; otherwise null. Visit counts cover a rolling 60-minute process-local window, reset on restart and retain at most 50,000 identities. No identities, IP addresses, filesystem paths or configuration secrets are returned.

visitors.description: Approximate retained authenticated-user or guest-IP identities, not distinct people; may undercount at the identity cap.

requests.description: Requests retained in the process counter; not page views or a durable audit.

AdminOverview.description: Permission-filtered aggregate snapshot. More than 500 candidate walls BEFORE per-wall permission filtering is rejected with OVERVIEW_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE; no partial aggregates are returned. Counts never expose anonymous identities, private message bodies, real names or IP addresses.

generated_at.description: Snapshot generation time in UTC ISO 8601.

daily.description: Exactly range.days consecutive server-local dates in ascending order, including zero-activity dates. Account counts remain null when unavailable.

AdminWallDeletionCounts.description: All 19 fields are always present and are nonnegative integers. Counts describe target-wall records and attachment candidates only; they are not account/global totals.

attachments.description: Attachment candidates associated with the wall; all are retained in this release. This is not a count of deleted disk files.

deletable_attachments.description: Always 0 in this release: wall deletion never physically unlinks disk files.

retained_attachments.description: All attachment candidates are retained; retained_attachments=attachments in this release. Independent storage cleanup requires fresh reference checks.

warnings.description: Explains that all candidate attachments are retained and independent storage cleanup requires fresh reference checks; do not interpret localized text as error codes.

can_delete.description: The preview is available to this authorized operator; deletion still requires fresh exact-name and current-password confirmation.

confirm_name.description: Exact current wall name; no trimming, case folding or Unicode normalization.

password.description: Current password of the authenticated operator; never persist or log this value.

warnings.description: Explains that all candidate attachments are retained and independent storage cleanup requires fresh reference checks. A successful response confirms committed database deletion only, not physical file removal.

db_size.description: Persisted database bytes, or zero if unavailable.

rows.description: Table row counts; null if an individual count failed.

AdminBackupName.description: Server-generated SQLite backup name; old names without the random suffix remain readable.

items.description: IPv4, IPv6 or supported wildcard characters; trimmed, blank entries removed and duplicates collapsed.

code.description: Private 6-character code for the same authenticated session; do not log or auto-execute.
Server compares uppercase. Five invalid attempts invalidate the pending code.

token.description: Short-lived (10 minute) ordinary API JWT. Keep in memory; never put in a URL or log.

error.description: Localized error; no v1 data/error/meta envelope on standalone dashboard endpoints.

created_at.description: Legacy SQLite local wall-clock YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, without an offset. Do not append Z.

decided_at.description: Legacy SQLite local wall-clock YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, without an offset. Do not append Z.

ConfessionIdentityRequest.description: The requester is the original recipient. No original anonymous author identity is included.

registered_at.description: users.created_at returned as stored, normally YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss in server local time without an offset; null for missing historical values. Do not assume UTC or append Z.

walls_joined.description: Distinct joined walls where both wall and own membership are active; pending, banned and inactive memberships or walls do not count.

friends.description: Distinct existing opposite account IDs in accepted friend relations in either direction, regardless of the opposite account status; reciprocal duplicates, self-relations and orphan peers do not count. Pending and blocked relation rows do not count.

named_posts.description: Own posts with author_id equal to the authenticated user and is_anonymous = 0. Anonymous posts, including legacy rows retaining author_id, are excluded; ownership is never inferred from IP or content.

comments.description: Existing comments whose author_id is the authenticated user.

bookmarks.description: Distinct bookmarked post IDs belonging to the authenticated user whose posts still exist.

votes_participated.description: Distinct vote IDs in own vote_records whose votes still exist; duplicate legacy records count once.

page.description: Positive safe page; (page - 1) * limit must also be a safe integer.

receiver_id.description: Positive safe ID. Decimal strings are also accepted.

wall_id.description: Positive safe ID. Decimal strings are also accepted.

client_message_id.description: Optional on legacy API; SDK always supplies a cryptographically generated or caller-provided stable key. Scope is authenticated sender.
